summary: Phase 81.29 Reminder Scheduler Testing completed. All 17 tests passed. Verified: (1) Scheduler tick() correctly scans docflow_documents for due template-flow reminders, (2) Scheduler writes reminder_state back to docflow_documents (not docflow_package_runs) for template-flow documents, (3) Scheduler still works for docflow_package_runs (no regression), (4) generate_document persists reminder_config and reminder_state to each recipient, (5) Soft-cancel logic when recipient status becomes 'completed', (6) cancel_recipient_reminders and cancel_run_reminders helpers target both collections, (7) POST /api/v1/documents/generate-links with reminder_enabled=true persists reminder configuration. Fixed 1 bug: Recipient model was missing reminder_config and reminder_state fields.
